author: bdanzi
body:
As per title, the PR aligns the offline phase-2 mkFit+LST JSON (`mkfit-phase2-lstStep-offline.json`) to the HLT phase-2 mkFit JSON (`mkfit-phase2-lstStep.json`, modified and merged in #22) with the changes of:
- duplicate cleaner changed to _phase2:clean_duplicates_sharedhits_pixelpriority_ (introduced in cms-sw/cmssw#52015);
- backward-fit outlier rejection: chi2 20, at most 3 outliers, tracks above 5 GeV;
- direction-only duplicate check off (dc_drth_central/obarrel/forward = 0). 
- The seed handling stays as in the offline JSON, since the seeding between offline and HLT currently is different (_m_seed_cleaner_name phase1:default, maxCandsPerSeed 3, m_requires_seed_hit_sorting true_).

## Physics Validation
- Full offline tracking performance: [QCD Pt1800-2400](http://uaf-3.t2.ucsd.edu/~bdanzi/Phase2Offline/PRTests_52011_52015_JetCore_20261008/qcd/12_pre4_vs_recipe/), [ttbar PU200](http://uaf-3.t2.ucsd.edu/~bdanzi/Phase2Offline/PRTests_52011_52015_JetCore_20261008/ttbar/12_pre4_vs_recipe/)
- First two tracking iterations performance:  [QCD Pt1800-2400](http://uaf-3.t2.ucsd.edu/~bdanzi/Phase2Offline/PRTests_52011_52015_JetCore_20261008/qcd/12_pre4_vs_recipe_Iters01) , [ttbar PU200](http://uaf-3.t2.ucsd.edu/~bdanzi/Phase2Offline/PRTests_52011_52015_JetCore_20261008/ttbar/12_pre4_vs_recipe_Iters01)
Curves in plots: `CMSSW`: `CMSSW_20_1_0_pre4` offline tracking default, `LST_pre4`: LST+mkFit offline tracking default in pre4, `LST_recipe`: cms-sw/cmssw#52011  + cms-sw/cmssw#52015  + this PR

**Physics summary**:
- **Efficiency in dense environments (jets)**: In plain pre4 (`LST_pre4` curve), the first two tracking iterations lose a large fraction of the efficiency in high-pT jets: 0.31 at pT > 100 GeV in QCD. The recipe roughly doubles it, to 0.64. It also improves it from 0.68 to 0.84 at pT > 10 GeV and from 0.82 to 0.875 at pT > 0.9 GeV. Both parts of the recipe contribute:
  - The LST/mkFit updates of #52011/#52015 account for most of the gain: 0.31  0.53 at pT > 100 GeV.
  - The new proposed offline JSON adds the rest: 0.53  0.64. It relaxes the mkFit duplicate cleaning (pixel-priority cleaner, dc_drth = 0) and adds backward-fit outlier rejection, so candidates in jet cores are kept.
The efficiency in ttbar is essentially unchanged: 0.877  0.880 at pT > 0.9 GeV and 0.92  0.94 at pT > 10 GeV. The gain is specific to dense environments.
- **Fake rate**: It decreases, mostly thanks to #52011/#52015. In QCD it goes from 0.18 to 0.12 at pT > 10 GeV and from 0.15 to 0.12 at pT > 100 GeV. For high-purity tracks at pT > 0.9 GeV it goes from 0.028 to 0.020.
- **Duplicate rate**: the increase comes from the relaxed duplicate cleaning in the JSON. It stays within a few percent: from 0.5% to 0.8% inclusively (pT > 0.9 GeV, both QCD and TTbar) and from 0% to 2.3% at pT > 100 GeV in QCD. The LST+mkFit with all iterations stays below 8%. Few fixes in `CMSSW` are needed to lower it further with future PRs.
title: Use the new pixel-priority duplicate cleaner for mkFit+LST in Phase-2 offline tracking
